relationships.subject: interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome
relationships.evidence_quote: Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) is another pro-inflammatory cytokine that was elevated in the plasma of individuals with IC/BPS

relationships.subject: interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome
relationships.evidence_quote: Plasma TNF-ɑ levels were also significantly elevated in patients with IC/BPS compared to HS

key_findings: IC/BPS patients had reduced monocyte and increased lymphocyte bioenergetics and elevated plasma IFN-gamma, TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-8 and VEGF.
TNF-alpha and IL-8 correlated with monocyte mitochondrial parameters in IC/BPS.
